I ran a query for each task against its input file, and each one returned a plausible answer. I did not cross-check any of them against the raw data by hand.

- **T1 to T4:** the T1 query returned 4, T2 returned alice, carol, erin and ivan, and T4 returned 33.17. The T3 query had an untested step order: I ran an earlier version of it, which gave US 3, DE 2, FR 2 and unknown 2. Its final form is the one I did not re-run.
- **T5 to T7:** T5 returned bug, feature, performance, tests, urgent. T6 returned 106 (carol), 102 (null) and 108 (null). T7 returned alice 3 and bob 1.
- **T8 and T9:** T8 returned five `name@^version` strings, starting with eslint and ending with zod. T9 returned `auth,reports,search`.
- **T10 and T11:** T10 returned db 3, api 1 and worker 1. T11 returned 330.2.
- **T12 to T14:** T12 returned 204.91. T13 returned Birch 109.97 and Acme 104.96. T14 returned `elderberry-banana-cherry-apple-date-kiwi-fig`.

The T10 map's keys print as keywords (`:db`), because every key of a map is a keyword in qlang. The T3 and T7 queries have the same property.

The queries below begin with `| ` so the Git Bash path conversion leaves them alone.

T1: | /data/users | filter ~(allOf /active (at :email | coalesce "" | lower | endsWith "@example.com")) | count
T2: | /data/users | filter ~(/roles | any ~(lower | eq "admin")) * /name | sort ~(lower)
T3: | /data/users | groupBy ~(at :profile | coalesce {} | at :country | coalesce "unknown") * count
T4: | /data/users * (at :profile | coalesce {} | at :age) | filter ~(ne null) | avg | round 2
T5: | filter ~(/state | eq "open") * (/labels * /name * lower) | flat | distinct | sort
T6: | sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 * {:number /number :assignee (at :assignee | coalesce {} | at :login)}
T7: | filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(at :assignee | ne null) | groupBy ~(/assignee/login) * count
T8: | [/dependencies /devDependencies] | reduce {} ~(union) | entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | sort ~(/0) * ([(/0 | keyword) /1] | join "@")
T9: | /services | filter ~(allOf (at :enabled | eq true) (/port | gt 8000)) * (/name | lower) | sort | join ","
T10: | lines | filter ~(ne "") | filter ~(split " " | /1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy ~(split " " | /2) * count
T11: | lines | filter ~(contains "ms=") * (split " " | filter ~(startsWith "ms=") | first | drop 3 | parseJson) | avg | round 1
T12: | lines | drop 1 | filter ~(ne "") * (split "," | {:c /1 :q (/3 | parseJson) :p (/4) :s (/5 | lower)}) | filter ~(allOf (/p | ne "") (/s | eq "shipped")) * (mulOf /q (/p | parseJson)) | sum | round 2
T13: | lines | drop 1 | filter ~(ne "") * (split "," | {:c /1 :q (/3 | parseJson) :p (/4) :s (/5 | lower)}) | filter ~(allOf (/p | ne "") (/s | ne "cancelled")) * {:c /c :t (mulOf /q (/p | parseJson))} | groupBy ~(/c) * (* /t | sum) | entries * {:customer (/0 | keyword) :total (/1 | round 2)} | sort ~(/total | desc) | take 2
T14: | ["Banana","apple","Cherry","banana","fig","APPLE","date","kiwi","Fig","elderberry"] * lower | distinct | sort ~([(count | desc) /]) | join "-"
